title: Red velvet
content: Hey everyone, I’ve been having ‘mallworld’ dreams for way over 35 years, back when there was no internet 😱 ‘the dark ages’ ☺️… when I found this group I was absolutely so shocked that I’m not the only one. The more I read, the more bewildered I am. My dreams have been so vivid and varied throughout the years thats it’s impossible to tell you every detail. But mainly years ago it was tiered white swimming pool resorts, beaches waves, alien invasions from the sky, performing on stage in musicals (me not the aliens ☺️), water park under a high scary road, hiding dead bodies in shallow water, picking up diamonds on the beach, lots of high waves… My mallworld has changed so much now, there’s a lot more parking cars, trying to drive a car from the back seat, working in a highrise glass building with lifts (elevators) that are badly built. , I visit so many places that it would take me ages to explain. But one thing keeps jumping out at me. When I was young RED VELVET was a frequent theme, red velvet walls, ceiling, stairs, mostly grand almost royal hallways and bedrooms, sometime dark wood and red velvet, but also gold cream white, really ornate. ….. but it’s the red velvet bit that’s fascinating me… I keep seeing it popping up in other posts. Now I’m older red velvet seems too have gone from my dreams…. but it was such a big part before. I just can’t work out what this all means.
